description:
Cut over every repository-owned mutation consumer — init, profiles, config, project render, issue/dependency/gate/template/document/archive/migration/validation mutations, claim's repository-side sync, and repository-contained exports — to the final `repository_state` APIs, marker primitive, and transaction boundary, and delete every superseded predecessor path on `main` in the same change. This completes Group A's cumulative stack ahead of the integration leaf.

## Background

With the pure core, the layout-aware store, typed mutation, and materializers in place on `main`, the remaining command-local publishers, snapshot/projection helpers, init/profile transaction builders, and adapters must be migrated and removed so no second source-of-truth inventory or command-local publication path survives. Deletion happens here — not deferred to integration or assurance.

## What to build

- Complete typed-mutation cutover: audit the exhaustive mutating-command classifier and migrate every repository-owned issue/declaration/event/provenance/gate-run/export publication to one typed mutation via `RepositoryStateStore::apply`. This includes init/profiles/config/render; every issue/dependency/gate/template/document/archive/migration/validation mutation; artifact moves; the current split gate producers; and claim acquire's repository-side issue/event synchronization (lease surface otherwise unchanged).
- Permanent Git-optional attributes contract: the boundary acquires typed Git evidence before init. The `.gitattributes` line-set claim is eligible only when Git identifies a containing worktree and the selected data root is inside it; otherwise status is exactly `not_applicable`, no target is captured, and init succeeds. Eligible init claims the Git-escaped worktree-relative data-root path plus `/events.jsonl merge=union` in the same delta, preserves every unrelated byte, and reports `unchanged`/`created`/`modified` with created/modified path lists. Unsafe eligible content (symlink/directory/unsupported/malformed/competing claim) is a typed preflight error aborting init before journaling. Delete the warning-only post-init `setup_gitattributes` writer and its CLI warning/report merge; Git stays optional for core commands (`@/charter/D-4`).
- Export mutation classification: stdout export stays read-only; every filesystem destination passes through `classify_and_canonicalize` (nested-data → `Data(...)`, remaining worktree → `Worktree(...)`, other → external output). A virtual destination becomes a `RepositoryStateStore` export intent with target/parent capture, expected preimage, ownership, and recovery; no exporter/packager bypasses canonical duplicate checks. External checker subprocesses, `.git/jit` coordination, gitignored worktree/server state, journals, and user-global config remain separate control planes.
- Canonical profile consumers: `profile::package` exports semantic contributions as `declarations` edits and assets/regions as `repository_state::TargetClaim` values; `profile::drift` and its filesystem traversal disappear, replaced by `compare_materializations` over the captured image; `profile::dogfood` live assets/regions flow through the same claims; `profile::application` keeps public provenance/response envelopes adapted from `RepositoryDelta` but imports no profile mode or final-byte type; `profile::preset` no longer owns projections, asset modes, or a compatibility inventory; `commands::{profile,init}` use only the recovered layout-aware session.
- Predecessor deletion (definitions, exports, production calls, direct tests, forwarding doubles): `refresh_default_schema_projections`, `sync_default_rule_membership`, `RuleMembershipSync`, `scaffold_default_rules`; `ruleset_store` writers/readers; `config_store::seed_repo_config` and generic `save_config_document`; `gate_store::save_gate_registry` and `IssueStore::{save_gate_registry, save_gate_preset, write_repo_file}`; project-render's pending/write loop; `IssueStore`/JSON/memory/`CommandExecutor` init publishers; repository-publishing `IssueStore::{save_issue, restore_issue_verbatim, delete_issue, append_event, save_gate_run_result}`; standalone `.gitattributes` setup/warning code; repository-contained graph/snapshot raw writers; ID/time-producing constructors/call paths; init/profile torn-tail helpers; command-local init/profile transaction builders; the independent `RecoveryCoordinator::recover_before_services` route and storage-parent resolver; `commands::profile::transaction_path`; `.jit` prefix translation and string/absolute-path adapters; validation's ambient `JitConfig::load` fallback; and the boundary plan-document resolver's mutation-path filesystem reads (replaced by image-projected content). Also delete the superseded profile inventory: `PackageProjection`, `ProjectedFile(Mode)`, `project_package`, `write_projection_tree`, `render_managed_region`, `profile/render.rs`; `RepositorySnapshot`/`SnapshotEntry`/`SnapshotFile`/`capture_profile_snapshot`/`capture_profile_path`; `profile::drift` comparison/finding/error types; `jit_dogfood_live_projection`/`preserve_nested_region`; `PresetProjection`/`PresetInventory`/asset-mode projection; `ProfileApplicationPlan`/`PlannedTarget(Action)`/`plan_profile_application_against`; and `InitScaffold`/`FreshProfilePlan.changed_files` final-target inventories plus init/profile `FileTransactionPlan` builders and path/mode adapters. `IssueStore` becomes read/query-only for repository-owned typed records.

Distilled §2 contracts: complete typed-mutation cutover and explicit dispositions, permanent Git-optional attributes contract, export mutation classification, canonical profile consumers, and the exact superseded publisher/init/layout and profile inventories. See `dev/active/cdc840ad-plan.md` §2 and plan decisions D2, D17, D18 for full detail.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: All affected commands pass targeted plus cumulative human/JSON/schema/MCP tests.
- [hard] REQ-02: Live-tree absence scans are clean now; deletion is not deferred to integration or assurance.

## Constraints

- Invoker-approved delivery model (2026-07-19): cumulative final-form wave commits land directly on `main`. The retired `integration/cdc840ad` branch is not authoritative and no integration-only final transition is required. Each commit runs targeted tests plus all prior cumulative package tests, including human/JSON/schema/MCP contract tests for affected commands.
- No adapter, feature flag, compatibility re-export, dual path, temporary API, or duplicate source-of-truth inventory survives. Every repository publication is `RepositoryStateStore::apply`.
- Predecessor deletion completes here; it is not deferred to integration or assurance.
- Out of scope (plan D19/D20): lease credential/claim-log/claim-command redesign — claim acquire migrates only its repository-side issue/event sync; and any worktree/data-root binding redesign.

Blast radius: all commands/adapters/fixtures, docs-generated contracts (server and MCP surfaces), and the structural absence scans enumerated in §2.
title: Migrate all consumers and delete predecessors
